title: AI Industry Not Ready For Coming Crisis, Says Mukunda
text: Leading AI executives are reportedly preparing for the possibility of a major AI-caused disaster within the next six to 12 months. AI systems have already been linked to multiple cybersecurity incidents, including breaches of outside systems and attacks affecting tens of thousands. Gautam Mukunda, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist & Lecturer at the Yale School of Management, explains why those incidents may be indicative of a much larger problem. (Source: Bloomberg)
